## Quality Control and Exceptions  
A second reviewer checks high-risk files. A missing document is not a minor
exception: resolve it or escalate under `[[sop_exception_handling]]`. Apply
`[[policy_customer_identification_v2]]` if policy and training material differ.

raw_entities.name: Quality Control and Exceptions Procedure
raw_entities.description: A procedure for managing quality control reviews and exception handling in file processing. High-risk files undergo secondary review, and missing documents trigger escalation rather than being treated as minor exceptions. Policy conflicts are resolved by applying the current customer identification policy.
context: A second reviewer checks high-risk files.
A missing document is not a minor exception: resolve it or escalate under `[[sop_exception_handling]]`.
Apply `[[policy_customer_identification_v2]]` if policy and training material differ.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk File Secondary Review
raw_entities.description: A second reviewer conducts quality control checks on high-risk files as part of the exception handling procedure.
context: A second reviewer checks high-risk files.

raw_entities.name: Missing Document Resolution or Escalation
raw_entities.description: When a document is missing from a file, the exception must be resolved or escalated according to the exception handling SOP rather than being treated as a minor issue.
context: A missing document is not a minor exception: resolve it or escalate under `[[sop_exception_handling]]`.

raw_entities.name: Policy Conflict Resolution
raw_entities.description: When policy documentation and training materials conflict, the current customer identification policy version 2 is applied to resolve the discrepancy.
context: Apply `[[policy_customer_identification_v2]]` if policy and training material differ.

raw_entities.name: Second Reviewer
raw_entities.description: An operations staff member responsible for conducting secondary quality control reviews on high-risk files to ensure compliance and accuracy.
context: A second reviewer checks high-risk files.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identification Verification
raw_entities.description: A compliance checkpoint requiring verification of customer identification documentation. The current policy version (v2) governs the standards and procedures for this verification when conflicts arise between policy and training materials.
context: Apply `[[policy_customer_identification_v2]]` if policy and training material differ.
